about: Hand-kept input of the screen object catalogue (build.py reads it with the fixture exports, seen.json and TIA's help).
types: the toolbox objects in toolbox order, then the objects a screen holds besides them. Per type:
key: the export element without 'Hmi.Screen.' (null for a control whose element is unknown); toolbox: group and name
as the toolbox shows them; help: the object's title in TIA's VBS object reference (Help\en-US\VBSObjectsWCCCenUS.zip);
purpose: what the object is for, in our own words.
rows: TIA's Properties window (table view) of the object as dropped with no setting changed, device style WinCC Dark,
transcribed from screenshots (2026-10-31): 'Group | Display name | target | shown value | flags'.
target: an export attribute; '@Name' an ObjectList member of that CompositionName (font or text);
'link:Name' a LinkList entry; 'tag:Name' a Properties entry with a tag connection; '-' not in the export.
A trailing '?' on a link or tag name: that name was not seen in an export yet.
flags: grey (drawn grey in the screenshot), cut (the name was cut off in the screenshot: either completed from
the same suffix seen whole elsewhere, '(border)', '(layout)', '(appearance)', or left with '...' at the cut),
unsure (which export attribute the row is, is not certain).
greyed: export name -> conditions, any of which greys the row ('Attr = v', 'Attr != v', 'Attr in a, b', 'always').
Only conditions seen in several screenshots or obvious from the object; the default-state grey of a screenshot
is not a condition by itself.
modes: TIA help mode name -> export spelling of Mode, for the help's mode tables (build.py).
helpValuesWrong: attributes whose values on the help's property page belong to other objects (the Mode page
lists the I/O field's modes for the button too, CornerStyle line styles, TickStyle the slider's marks); their
documented values are left out.
preview: what the HMI preview draws (state drawn | partial | placeholder | none; drawn; notDrawn with the reason).
descriptions: one line per export attribute, composition ('@'), link ('link:'), tag ('tag:') or display-only row
('~' + display name), in our own words (TIA's help is Siemens' text and is not copied).
enumTypes: export attribute ('Attr', or 'Key.Attr' for one type) -> TIA's enum type of it in enums.json (a name
without a namespace is in GraphX). Chosen by name and by the spellings seen in exports; an attribute whose enum
is not clear is left out.

descriptions.ShowDecimalPoint: Writes the scale labels with one decimal place.
descriptions.ShowDropDownButton: Shows the button that opens the selection list.
descriptions.ShowDropDownList: Shows the selection list when the field is operated.
descriptions.ShowLeadingZeros: Fills the field with leading zeros.
descriptions.ShowLimitLines: Draws the limits as lines across the bar.
descriptions.ShowLimitMarkers: Marks the limits at the scale.
descriptions.ShowLimitRanges: Takes the range limits from a tag instead of the fixed values.
descriptions.ShowPeakValuePointer: Shows a second pointer that stays at the highest value reached.
descriptions.ShowPosition: Writes the current value as a number.
descriptions.ShowProcessValue: Writes the current value at the bar.
descriptions.ShowScrollBar: Whether a scroll bar is shown.
descriptions.ShowTableGridlines: Draws lines between the table cells.
descriptions.ShowTickLabels: Writes values at the scale marks.
descriptions.ShowTicks: Draws the scale marks (on a clock the hour marks).
descriptions.StartLeft: X of the line's start point.
descriptions.StartStyle: Shape at the start of the line (none, arrow ...).
descriptions.StartTop: Y of the line's start point.
descriptions.SwitchOrientation: Direction the switch moves from OFF to ON.
descriptions.TabIndex: Position in the tab order (keyboard operation); -1 for objects that take no input. Not shown in the Properties window.
descriptions.TableEvenRowBackColor: Background of every second table row.
descriptions.TableForeColor: Text colour of the table cells.
descriptions.TableGridlineColor: Colour of the lines between the cells.
descriptions.TableHeaderBackFillStyle: How the table header is filled: solid or a gradient.
descriptions.TableHeaderBorderBackColor: Second colour of the table header's border.
descriptions.TableHeaderBorderColor: Colour of the table header's border.
descriptions.TableHeaderBorderWidth: Width of the table header's border in pixels.
descriptions.TableHeaderCornerRadius: Corner radius of the table header in pixels.
descriptions.TableHeaderEdgeStyle: Line style of the table header's border.
descriptions.TableHeaderFirstGradientColor: Colour at the first gradient stop of the table header.
descriptions.TableHeaderFirstGradientOffset: Position of the table header's first gradient stop, in percent.
descriptions.TableHeaderForeColor: Text colour of the table header.
descriptions.TableHeaderMiddleGradientColor: Middle colour of the table header's gradient.
descriptions.TableHeaderSecondGradientColor: Colour at the second gradient stop of the table header.
descriptions.TableHeaderSecondGradientOffset: Position of the table header's second gradient stop, in percent.
descriptions.TextAreaBottomMargin: Space in pixels between the text and the bottom edge.
descriptions.TextAreaLeftMargin: Space in pixels between the text and the left edge.
descriptions.TextAreaRightMargin: Space in pixels between the text and the right edge.
descriptions.TextAreaTopMargin: Space in pixels between the text and the top edge.
descriptions.TextOrientation: Direction of the text: horizontal or rotated.
descriptions.TickDistance: Distance of the hour marks from the centre, in percent of the radius.
descriptions.Top: Y of the object's top left corner on the screen.
descriptions.TopMargin: Space in pixels between the text and the top edge.
descriptions.TransparentColor: Colour of the graphic that is drawn transparent.
descriptions.Unit: Unit text written after the value.
descriptions.UnitTop: Height of the unit text on the dial, as a share of the dial.
descriptions.UseAutoScaling: Sets the scale from the minimum and maximum value automatically.
descriptions.UseDesignColorSchema: Takes the colours from the device style instead of the object's own settings.
descriptions.UseExponentialFormat: Writes the scale labels in exponential form.
descriptions.UseTableHeaderFirstGradient: Uses the first gradient stop in the table header.
descriptions.UseTableHeaderSecondGradient: Uses the second gradient stop in the table header.
descriptions.UseTransparentColor: Draws the TransparentColor of the graphic transparent.
descriptions.UseTwoHandOperation: Needs a second key held at the same time (two-hand operation).
descriptions.VerticalAlignment: Vertical position of the text in the object.
descriptions.VerticalPictureAlignment: Vertical position of the graphic in the object.
descriptions.VerticalScrolling: Lets the operator scroll the table vertically.
descriptions.VisibleES: Whether the layer is shown in the editor.
descriptions.SetTabOrderInFront: Puts the template's objects before the screen's objects in the tab order.
descriptions.ScrollbarBackgroundColor: Background colour of the pop-up's scroll bars.
descriptions.ScrollbarForegroundColor: Colour of the pop-up's scroll bar handles.
descriptions.FaceplateTypeName: Faceplate type and version of the project library ('_Library@$@<folder>@$@<type> V x.y.z').
descriptions.Resizing: How the instance follows a size change: not at all, or keeping the type's aspect ratio.
descriptions.GlobalAssignment: Uses the function key's global assignment (from the template) instead of a local one.
descriptions.KeyCode: Code of the function key (F1, F2 ... on key panels).
descriptions.LEDTagBitNumber: Bit of the LED tag that lights the key's LED.
descriptions.Activate: Whether the slide-in screen is used. Meaning inferred from the name.
descriptions.Dimension: Depth of the slide-in screen in pixels. Meaning inferred from the name.
descriptions.LineColor1: First colour of the slide-in's handle lines. Meaning inferred from the name.
descriptions.LineColor2: Second colour of the slide-in's handle lines. Meaning inferred from the name.
descriptions.OperatableAreaColor: Colour of the area that opens the slide-in. Meaning inferred from the name.
descriptions.SlideinType: Panel edge the screen slides in from.
descriptions.Visibility: How the slide-in screen is shown (for example faded out when not in use).
descriptions.@TextOn: Text in the ON state, per language.
descriptions.@TextOff: Text in the OFF state, per language (the text of a text button).
descriptions.@Font: Font of the text, per language (family, size in pixels, style).
descriptions.@CaptionFont: Font of the label, per language.
descriptions.@PositionFont: Font of the value written at the slider, per language.
descriptions.@ScaleLabelFont: Font of the scale labels, per language.
descriptions.@UnitFont: Font of the unit text, per language.
descriptions.@TableFont: Font of the table cells, per language.
descriptions.@TableHeaderFont: Font of the table header, per language.
descriptions.link:StyleItem: Style item of the device style the object follows.
descriptions.link:Picture: Graphic of the project's graphics collection.
descriptions.link:PictureOff: Graphic in the OFF state (the graphic of a graphic button).
descriptions.link:GraphicList: Graphic list whose entries the tag's value selects.
descriptions.link:TextList: Text list whose entries the tag's value selects.
descriptions.link:Authorization: User right needed to operate the object.
descriptions.tag:ProcessValue: Tag the object shows or writes.
descriptions.~Layer: Layer the object is on (the export holds the object inside its layer).
descriptions.~Device style: Device style of the HMI device (not per object).
descriptions.~Flash on limit violation: Not in the export of this object.
descriptions.~Background fill pattern: Not in the export of this object.
descriptions.~Inner dimensions height: Inner height of the bar area; TIA computes it, not in the export.
descriptions.~Inner dimensions width: Inner width of the bar area; TIA computes it, not in the export.
descriptions.~Limit/Range collection: Editor for the limits and ranges; not in the export.
descriptions.~Value range Lower 1: Value range of the range; computed by TIA, not in the export.
descriptions.~Value range Lower 2: Value range of the range; computed by TIA, not in the export.
descriptions.~Value range Normal: Value range of the range; computed by TIA, not in the export.
descriptions.~Value range Upper 1: Value range of the range; computed by TIA, not in the export.
descriptions.~Value range Upper 2: Value range of the range; computed by TIA, not in the export.
